title: Projet d'appui à la gouvernance de la Ville de Djibouti (PROGOUV): sélection d'un expert SIG et adressage, termes de référence
why: Says street addressing exists only in a few central streets and one commune, no door numbers, with a pilot in Balbala and a 70 million FDJ allocation (underway, partial).

title: Country Conditions for Mailing - Djibouti
why: Records the 5-digit postcode system La Poste de Djibouti introduced on 27 June 2020, ten codes for post offices and delivery zones in all regions (in service, used by post).

title: Policies, Procedures, and Forms Updates (IMM Revision: Individual Country Listing for Djibouti)
why: Postal Bulletin notice that Djibouti introduced a postcode system of 10 codes, on La Poste de Djibouti's UPU request of 8 June 2020.

title: Djibouti (UPU addressing sheet)
why: UPU sheet gives 5-digit postcodes for all six regions plus what3words geocoded address line (in service nationwide).
